messages.text: Happy to check, I just need one detail to match it. What's the email on the order?

Good news, Eric, both units are out. The NerdOctaxe shipped July 24 and was delivered July 30. The NerdQX shipped July 31 on tracking ····: (tracking link hidden)

Did the NerdQX turn up? If only the Octaxe arrived, tell me and I'll get that second parcel chased.

I'm sorry, Eric. That second parcel carries the same tracking number as the one that reached you, so the NerdQX looks like it never physically went out. Two months with nothing is not on you.

I've pinged the team to get it sent, and I'm putting a $50 credit on your next order for the trouble. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here; if you step away, it comes to your email.
Before you go, one thing: the NerdQX has been missing since July, what made you leave it this long before telling us?
Cause the helium deploy team keep promising me a later date

That's not good enough, and I'm sorry you got strung along on it.

One more, if you don't mind: who was giving you those dates, someone in chat here or by email?

Thanks, Eric, that's useful and I've put it in front of the team with your order.

They're on now, so stay in the chat and one of them will pick up the NerdQX here. If you step away, it comes to your email.
Sounds good. I'll leave it with you, they'll be in shortly.
